sample_unit: not reported (clinical observations, interviews, and focus groups with clinicians and patients)

links.outcome: LLM interpretation of indirect, colloquial sexual and reproductive health language in clinical interactions
links.effect: LLMs struggled with semantic drift, myths, and polysemy when interpreting indirect communication in clinical interactions; no numeric results are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Our analysis identifies two axes of communication (referential domain and expression approach) and shows LLMs struggle with semantic drift, myths, and polysemy in clinical interactions.

unlisted_practices: Culturally situated design of LLMs for indirect communication in sexual and reproductive health

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM performance on real-world indirect sexual and reproductive health communication data collected from clinical observations and patient/clinician interviews, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
